In the occupied West Bank, 14 year-old Aws al-Nasaan was killed in a school shooting. Then, the Israeli army fired tear gas at students.

His principal told me the police never even talked to anyone at the school. They have no reason to believe the killer was brought to justice.

posts.text:
Dan, losing is hard. I lost twice. 

I lost to Tom Lantos when I ran the first anti-Iraq war primary in the nation in 2003. I was disappointed I got 19% to Lantos's 71% even though the district was overwhelmingly opposed to the war. Lantos said "young man unless you're a movie star you can't just get up and run. You need to do far more work in the community." It's a lesson I internalized.

The Trump Administration is sending billions to Amazon, Apple, Walmart, and other big corporations to refund them for Trump’s tariffs.

American households were estimated to lose over $1,000 to tariff price hikes.

Here's an idea: refund working families before big business.
